question: On new apple scenes, how often does the unchanged fine-tune need more than nine action requests to satisfy the frozen held-lift rule?
success_rule: Apple rises at least 0.08 m above settled height for at least 2 continuous seconds; exact action replay joint-state error must be under 0.005 m.
analysis_rule: Score the first 33 warm-up rows plus 48 action rows per request from the same recorded 12-request trajectory. Report the earliest request count meeting the success rule. Keep every invalid and partial run in the denominator record.
interpretation: This evaluates the effect of stopping a single model trajectory after nine rather than twelve requests. It does not measure model training, operator time, demonstration efficiency, or FaaS spend.
